# WindowHop 1.0.4
- Dock hover previews now fit tightly around their window cards, without the large header, footer, and empty background. - A short fade makes Dock previews open smoothly. Reduce Motion disables the animation. - Both the preview grid and compact vertical stack retain their window controls and hover selection.
Apple Silicon, macOS 13 or later. This free build is not Apple-notarized.
